entities.name: Charles Darwin
entities.description: English naturalist and biologist Charles Darwin, known for his theory of evolution, spent his early years as an apprentice doctor before attending the University of Edinburgh Medical School, where he found lectures dull and surgery distressing. He also learned taxidermy from John Edmonstone, a Black Briton from the South American rainforest, who had been taught by Charles Waterton and was freed from slavery. His contributions to evolutionary biology have been widely accepted and are considered a fundamental scientific concept.
